Privacy Policy

Updated 14 October 2026

Review draft. The postal contact address, correspondence retention rules and hosting contractual details need confirmation before final publication.

1. Who is responsible for your data

CalmSilver is the project brand operated by Andre Richard-Peter, Romania. PFA registration is in progress and has not been confirmed. We do not present the brand as an already registered company or PFA.

Website: https://calmsilver.com. Contact for questions and data rights: hello@calmsilver.com. The postal contact address has not yet been confirmed; no address or registration details are assumed.

2. Scope of this policy

This policy covers the static CalmSilver landing page and correspondence initiated by visitors. The page offers no accounts, payments, newsletter or chatbot. Describing products or services does not mean they process data through this page. Any future service with different data flows needs its own notice.

3. The form and your messages

The form uses your name, optional business name, project type and message to prepare an email locally. It makes no API submission and does not save the content to a database, cookies or localStorage. Copying the address or draft writes text to your clipboard only when you request it.

Preparing the email opens your email application. That application may save its own draft under its settings and policies. CalmSilver receives the message when you send it. Your name, sender address, message, any attachments and delivery metadata may then be processed. You can email hello@calmsilver.com directly without the form. Please avoid unnecessary passwords, card details or sensitive information.

4. Purposes and legal bases

We use correspondence to reply and discuss the project. Steps requested by an individual before a contract rely on GDPR Article 6(1)(b). For communications with business representatives, the intended basis is the legitimate interest in responding to professional enquiries, Article 6(1)(f); the assessment of that interest needs to be documented.

Optional language storage relies on your choice in the cookie panel and, where personal data is involved, Article 6(1)(a). Remembering that choice and technical protection have the limited purposes of respecting preferences and delivering the website safely. The legal classification and infrastructure providers’ roles need confirmation. Marketing consent is not a condition for receiving or answering a message.

Using the form is voluntary. Your name and message are required only to prepare the draft; the business name is optional. The page code performs no profiling or solely automated decisions with legal effects.

5. Technical data and browser storage

Delivering the page over HTTPS sends connection data, including the IP address and request and browser information, to the hosting infrastructure. ChatGPT Sites is the hosting platform. HTTP responses checked on 14 October 2026 include the Cloudflare bot protection cookie __cf_bm.

The page code contains no analytics scripts, advertising pixels, external fonts or AI integrations. It uses only calmsilver.consent and, with permission, calmsilver.language in localStorage. The Cookie Policy explains the inventory, durations and withdrawal. Inspecting code and HTTP responses does not reveal every internal platform log or operation.

6. Who may receive data

Andre Richard-Peter manages messages. Zoho Mail provides business email; the owner confirmed an EU account, sole access and no automatic forwarding. The page has no Zoho widget and the form sends no data directly to Zoho.

ChatGPT Sites provides hosting, and Cloudflare was observed in page delivery and protection. This observation does not by itself establish contractual relationships or a complete subprocessor list. The contracting entities, roles and applicable processing agreements must be checked for the actual accounts used. External links lead to services with their own policies.

7. Data locations and transfers

An EU Zoho account does not establish that all providers’ support operations, backups or transfers remain within the European Economic Area. The locations and mechanisms applicable to hosting and email have not been confirmed for these accounts. We do not claim a particular adequacy decision, standard contractual clauses or another mechanism without verification. These details and how to obtain applicable safeguards need to be completed before finalisation.

8. How long data is kept

The code gives calmsilver.consent a validity of 180 days. calmsilver.language is removed on withdrawal or when consent expiry is checked; localStorage has no automatic browser expiry. The infrastructure manages __cf_bm, with a documented duration of 30 minutes of inactivity.

There is no confirmed email retention or deletion rule yet. Operational periods or criteria for correspondence, attachments, copies and any hosting logs must be set or obtained from the providers. We do not assign an unverified tax or contractual retention period to messages.

9. Your rights

Subject to GDPR conditions, you may request access, rectification, erasure, restriction and, where applicable, data portability. You may object to processing based on legitimate interests. Withdraw language storage permission through Cookie settings without affecting the lawfulness of earlier processing.

Contact hello@calmsilver.com. Requests are normally handled within one month; an extension is possible under GDPR Article 12. Proportionate identity verification may be necessary. You may complain to ANSPDCP, Romania’s supervisory authority, or the competent authority where you live or work.

10. Security and updates

The checked page is served over HTTPS, uses its own resources and has no form submission endpoint or application database. These measures are not an absolute security guarantee and do not verify providers’ account security settings. We update this notice when features, providers or legal status change.
